contamination_note: Interim H3B base results for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT (net R by year and exit-reason counts) were seen before this protocol was written; no other H3B outcome was seen.
question: Are H3B entries informative, and if so, does a different stop/target/hold geometry chosen walk-forward produce positive out-of-sample expectancy?
entries: exactly the H3B_TREND_DOUBLE_BOTTOM_V1 replay entries (base run records): entry at the first 1m close at/after armed_at with adverse market slippage; original structural risk = risk_pct x entry

part_1_information_test.measure: signed forward return in units of original risk at 1h, 4h, 24h and 72h after entry (no stop/target)
part_1_information_test.baseline: 20 random entries per H3B trade: same symbol, same calendar year, same direction, same risk_pct, random 1m timestamps
part_1_information_test.statistic: mean difference H3B - random per horizon with day-block bootstrap 95% CI
part_1_information_test.reading: if no horizon's CI excludes 0 in H3B's favour, the entry carries no detectable information and exit tuning cannot create edge

part_2_exit_grid.fills: same-bar stop first; target exits maker without slippage; stop and time exits taker with slippage
part_2_exit_grid.costs: taker 5 bps, maker 2 bps; slippage 5 bps base, 10 bps stress

selection_walk_forward.fold_1: choose config with best mean net R (stress) on 2024 entries, evaluate on 2025 entries
selection_walk_forward.fold_2: choose on 2024-2025 entries, evaluate on 2026 entries
selection_walk_forward.oos_metric: concatenated 2025+2026 OOS mean net R per trade with day-block bootstrap 95% CI
comparators: original H3B geometry (1.0x stop, 2R, 72h) on the same OOS trades
selection_walk_forward.upper_bound_only: best config chosen on the full period (in-sample, biased upward); reported, never used as evidence

pass_condition: walk-forward OOS stress mean net R > 0 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND part 1 shows information; PASS authorizes a new frozen protocol (new id) with that geometry, evaluated forward only
scope_note: M0 failed-auction entries are excluded: their fill time is a trigger event not stored in replay records, and M0 is already negative before costs.
